task: Parse an AWS S3 bucket name from an S3 ARN string
solution_criteria: Should correctly extract bucket name from ARNs like 'arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket' or 'arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/path/to/object'

task: Validate an AWS IAM role ARN format
solution_criteria: Should match valid IAM role ARNs and reject invalid formats. Valid format: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/ROLE_NAME

task: Extract all AWS region codes from a CloudFormation template JSON
solution_criteria: Function should parse JSON and return list of unique regions referenced in the template

task: Create a minimal AWS Lambda function response JSON object
solution_criteria: Should include statusCode (200), headers with Content-Type, and a body with a simple message

task: Match AWS EC2 instance IDs in logs (format: i-XXXXXXXXX or i-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX)
solution_criteria: Should match valid EC2 instance IDs with 8 or 17 hex characters after 'i-'

task: Convert a list of AWS tags to a Python dictionary
solution_criteria: Function should accept a list of 'Key=Value' strings and return a dictionary, handling edge cases with special characters

task: Create a basic AWS Secrets Manager secret JSON structure
solution_criteria: Should include Name, Description, and SecretString fields with valid JSON formatting

task: Extract AWS account ID from various ARN formats using regex
solution_criteria: Should capture the 12-digit account ID from standard AWS ARNs (arn:aws:service:region:ACCOUNT_ID:resource)

task: Filter a list of EC2 instance names to find ones matching a pattern
solution_criteria: Function should accept a list of instance names and a pattern string, returning matching instances with wildcard support

task: Create an AWS DynamoDB item JSON with proper type descriptors
solution_criteria: Should include S (string), N (number), and BOOL type descriptors for attributes like id, name, and isActive
